title: What's Cooking in Business Central: Adding Resources to AL Applications

chapters.title: NAV App Resource Functions and Configuration
Working with JSON and Blob Data

features.name: Resources in AL Extensions
features.description: New capability to package data in Business Central extensions, including test data, sample data, configuration files, and blob data like images. Accessed via NAV App resource functions.
caveats: Resources can only be accessed within the app that owns them
Single resource file limited to 16 megabytes
Total resource files per extension limited to 256 megabytes

features.name: NAV App Get Resource As Json
features.description: Function to read resource files in JSON format. Part of convenience functions for resource interaction alongside get Resource, get Resource as text, and list resources.

features.name: Resource Folders Configuration
features.description: New property in app.json called resource folders that allows developers to specify which folders contain resources. Accepts an array to support multiple resource folders.

features.name: NAV App List Resources
features.description: Function to list and filter resources by pattern or folder. Supports wildcard patterns like *.jpg or folder paths. Returns all resources if no pattern is specified.

features.name: Resource Source Code Exposure Policies
features.description: Resources are treated as code. When allow downloading is enabled, resources are downloaded with source code. When disabled, resources are not included.
caveats: Additional limitations exist but not fully detailed in demo
